proposal.description_medium: In April 2020, Trump notified Congress that he intended to remove Intelligence Community Inspector General Michael Atkinson. His letter said he no longer had the “fullest confidence” in Atkinson but gave no detailed explanation. Atkinson was put on immediate administrative leave and had handled the Ukraine whistleblower complaint that became central to Trump’s first impeachment inquiry. Reporting supports the stated reason and sequence, but does not establish the critics’ claim that the removal was retaliation.
proposal.description_short: Trump removed Michael Atkinson in April 2020, saying he no longer had confidence in the inspector general who handled the Ukraine whistleblower complaint.

limitations: The notice did not give detailed grounds. Claims of retaliatory motive are attributed criticism, not established fact.
